title: 美国南部财富迁移加速 纳什维尔高价位住宅成交激增
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Nashville, Tennessee has always had rich residents, but now the money arriving is on a different scale.
segments.zh: 田纳西州纳什维尔一直有富裕居民，但现在涌入的资金规模不同以往。

segments.en: An influx of ultra-wealthy transplants are rapidly remaking the region, and are part of a broader migration of wealth toward the US South.
segments.zh: 超级富豪移民的涌入正在迅速重塑该地区，这是财富向美国南部迁移的大趋势的一部分。

segments.en: Nashville is known as a place with a booming economy, but I think what was surprising is the amount of wealth. It's something you might expect in Malibu and not necessarily in rural Tennessee.
segments.zh: 纳什维尔以经济繁荣著称，但令人惊讶的是财富的数量。这可能在马里布常见，但在田纳西乡村不一定。
